headline.en: See what changes in a tool-call response
headline.zh: 看清工具调用响应的变化

sub.en: ToolDrift normalizes tool-call responses into snapshots and compares their argument shape, encoding, call count, ID format and finish reason. Use saved responses or a configured probe suite before changing an endpoint.
sub.zh: ToolDrift 将工具调用响应归一化为快照，比较参数结构、编码、调用数、ID 格式和结束原因。更换端点前，可使用已保存响应或配置好的探测集合检查差异。

body.en: Arguments, emitted tools and response metadata remain separate diff entries.
body.zh: 参数、出现的工具和响应元数据分别列为差异项。

title.zh: 无需 API 即可回放

body.en: Saved snapshots and bundled fixtures can be compared entirely offline.
body.zh: 保存的快照和内置样本可完全离线比较。

body.en: A contract YAML can pin expected tool shapes alongside provider configuration.
body.zh: 契约 YAML 可在服务商配置旁固定预期工具结构。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The script runs the actual CLI with --from-fixtures and --format json, checks exit 1, and summarizes the field differences from the returned ContractDiff. It makes no provider calls.
note.zh: 脚本用 --from-fixtures 和 --format json 运行实际 CLI，核对退出码 1，并汇总返回 ContractDiff 的字段差异，不调用服务商。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Actual contract regression on bundled offline response fixtures; no live provider requests.

body.en: The script runs the actual CLI with --from-fixtures and --format json, checks exit 1, and summarizes the field differences from the returned ContractDiff. It makes no provider calls.
body.zh: 脚本用 --from-fixtures 和 --format json 运行实际 CLI，核对退出码 1，并汇总返回 ContractDiff 的字段差异，不调用服务商。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/tooldrift.git
cd tooldrift
uv venv --python 3.12
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .

limitations.en: A snapshot covers the responses collected for that suite. It is not a guarantee of all future tool calls or all prompt variants.
limitations.zh: 快照仅覆盖该测试集合收集的响应，不能保证未来所有工具调用或提示变体。

limitations.en: Field changes can be acceptable to a tolerant caller. Review the diff against your own parser and tool contract.
limitations.zh: 宽容的调用方可能接受某些字段变化，应结合自身解析器和工具约定审阅差异。

limitations.en: The recorded example is offline fixture replay, not a live five-provider benchmark. Streaming tool-call reassembly is not implemented.
limitations.zh: 记录示例是离线样本回放，不是五家服务商在线基准。流式工具调用重组尚未实现。

body.en: Two endpoints can accept the same request while returning arguments in different shapes. A field-level contract diff points directly to the parser or dispatcher assumption that needs review.
body.zh: 两个端点可能接受相同请求，却返回不同结构的参数。字段级契约差异能直接指出需要审阅的解析器或分发逻辑假设。

body.en: A YAML suite defines prompts and tool schemas. Probe loads fixture responses or calls configured chat-completion endpoints. contract.py turns each response into ToolCallShape entries within a ContractSnapshot. diff aligns tools by name and reports field changes; CLI output derives its exit code from any non-equivalence.
body.zh: YAML 测试集合定义提示和工具 Schema。Probe 读取样本响应，或调用已配置的 Chat Completions 端点。contract.py 将响应整理为 ContractSnapshot 中的 ToolCallShape。diff 按名称对齐工具并报告字段变化，CLI 对任意不等价差异返回相应退出码。

title.en: Probe or replay, normalize, then compare
title.zh: 探测或回放，归一化后比较

body.en: A YAML suite defines prompts and tool schemas. Probe loads fixture responses or calls configured chat-completion endpoints. contract.py turns each response into ToolCallShape entries within a ContractSnapshot. diff aligns tools by name and reports field changes; CLI output derives its exit code from any non-equivalence.
body.zh: YAML 测试集合定义提示和工具 Schema。Probe 读取样本响应，或调用已配置的 Chat Completions 端点。contract.py 将响应整理为 ContractSnapshot 中的 ToolCallShape。diff 按名称对齐工具并报告字段变化，CLI 对任意不等价差异返回相应退出码。

alt.en: Probe or replay, normalize, then compare
alt.zh: 探测或回放，归一化后比较

body.en: Provider aliases supply endpoint, model and key-environment defaults. The tool does not proxy application traffic or execute the model’s requested tools. Its fixtures are sample response data; their provider labels do not establish current behavior of any service.
body.zh: 服务商别名提供端点、模型和密钥环境变量默认值。工具不代理业务流量，也不执行模型请求的工具。内置样本是响应示例数据，样本上的服务商标签不能代表任何服务的当前行为。

body.en: contract.yaml defines version, suite, providers and optional expected tool shapes. Each provider can set base_url, model_id, api_key_env and request quirks. Built-in aliases include deepseek, qwen, kimi, glm and minimax. Before a live run, verify endpoint/model settings and configure the named key variables; dropping --from-fixtures sends billable model requests. Fixture mode refuses incompatible model overrides rather than relabeling saved data.
body.zh: contract.yaml 定义 version、suite、providers 和可选 expected 工具结构。各服务商可设置 base_url、model_id、api_key_env 和请求差异参数。内置别名包含 deepseek、qwen、kimi、glm、minimax。在线运行前需核对端点、模型及密钥变量；去掉 --from-fixtures 会发送可能计费的模型请求。样本模式拒绝不兼容模型覆盖，不会给已保存数据换标签。

body.en: snapshot writes a reusable JSON contract. diff compares saved files offline. run supports either --old/--new or --contract with optional repeated --base selections. compare-table renders a Markdown comparison for available snapshots. Commands reporting drift intentionally return 1, including warning-class differences; command/input failures are distinct errors.
body.zh: snapshot 写出可复用 JSON 契约，diff 离线比较文件。run 可使用 --old/--new，或 --contract 配合可重复 --base 选择。compare-table 为可用快照生成 Markdown 比较表。报告差异的命令按预期返回 1，包括 warning 类差异；命令或输入失败属于另一类错误。

details.code:
.venv/bin/tooldrift snapshot --base deepseek --from-fixtures -o before.json
.venv/bin/tooldrift snapshot --base qwen --from-fixtures -o after.json
.venv/bin/tooldrift diff before.json after.json --format json
.venv/bin/tooldrift run --contract examples/contract.yaml --base deepseek --base qwen --from-fixtures --format json
